items.title: Modernizing Enterprise GRC for Continuous Assurance - with Craig Unger of Hyperproof
items.summary: Shifting regulations and siloed risk and compliance functions are forcing enterprise leaders to rethink audit-driven compliance. In this episode, Craig Unger, CEO and Founder at Hyperproof, explains why compliance should be treated as a continuous state, with every control tied back to the organization's overall risk profile. He also covers standardizing a single set of controls across frameworks and regions, expressing risk in financial terms for boards, and using a five-stage maturity model to plan next steps.
